chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: What is the concept?

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: It is a simple thing.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: It is about demand and supply.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: The way our demand changes, we have to supply things in the same way.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: The main difference here is that in ETL, we extract data first.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: We extract multiple resources and then we integrate it and transform it.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: What happens in transformation?

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: For example, duplicate data, missing data, which is called data cleaning.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: Duplicate data, missing data, errors, remove them from there.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: Then transform that data.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: In the transform, we normalize it, do discretization.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: After cleaning a lot of things, finally we load it.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: After loading, whoever wants to use it on a daily basis,

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: can put that data in Power BI or Tableau and do analysis.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: On top of that, any insights can be taken from it so that it can take a decision.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: This is a simple story.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: But here a little change has happened.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: After loading, what are we doing later?

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: We are transforming it.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: Here comes a new term.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: We have heard of data warehouse.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: Data warehouse means a place where we extract our data from different places.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: Then we clean it and load it in the warehouse.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: After that, we can use it as we want.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: Here comes a new term, data lake.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: We don't want to do transformation.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: We have to load raw data, unstructured data first.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: After loading, we will transform it later.

chunks.title: ETL vs ELT in Data Warehouse 🏭
chunks.text: Based on our requirement, we use this or that.
